method: Match gate badge-ins to live location signal. Badge-ins with no active location signal are held as exceptions rather than counted or discarded.
auditNote: Reconciliation run and its exception list are written to an immutable, timestamped record for audit.

sources.name: Gate access-control
sources.note: Counts badge-ins net of badge-outs. Over-reports: it cannot tell that a tag was left in a vehicle or a locker.
sources.reliability: high for entry events, low for current presence

sources.name: Permit-to-work system
sources.note: Counts only people working under an open permit, so it never sees the support and logistics population.
sources.reliability: high, but partial coverage by design

sources.name: Contractor timesheets
sources.note: Submitted per contractor company on each company's own cadence. Lags the gate by hours and under-reports during a surge.

groups.label: Badged in, location signal stale over 10 minutes
groups.likelyCause: Tag left in a vehicle or a locker
